text.tspan: EKS latency: first find WHERE the time goes, then go one layer deeper
0. Scope it: all services or one? all users or one region/AZ? since when (deploy, traffic spike, scaling event)?
Look at p50 vs p99 latency, error rate, traffic (Grafana / CloudWatch Container Insights / traces)
kubectl top pods/nodes · kubectl describe pod (restarts, events) · kubectl get hpa (maxed out?)
CoreDNS: coredns_dns_request_duration_seconds, SERVFAIL rate; test: kubectl exec ... -- time nslookup svc
Traces (X-Ray / Jaeger / Tempo) show which hop is slow · RDS Performance Insights for the DB
Common fixes: raise/remove CPU limits that throttle, scale out (HPA, more nodes), NodeLocal DNSCache or ndots:2 / FQDN,
topology-aware routing to stay in-AZ, connection pooling (PgBouncer/RDS Proxy), fix the slow query, bigger instance types
